localChanges: chore: update core-unit, core-game, core-save-game and civ1-unit

log: A unit another player destroys counts as a loss for its owner, cargo going down with it at sea included; one destroyed by no one (disbanding, founding or joining a city, a spent Diplomat or Caravan) or by its own player (a nuclear weapon spending itself) doesn't. A transport lost at sea counts, with its cargo, in a LostAtSea rule before it's destroyed (civ-clone/web-renderer#405).

A defeated stack's cargo goes down with its transport, then comes up again in the stack's snapshot, so Destroyed ran twice for it and the loss counted twice. count-loss now skips a unit already destroyed, and lostAtSea skips cargo already gone. Found in review of civ-clone/web-renderer#639.
chore: require core-game 0.1.15 and core-unit 0.1.29, for unit losses
A UnitLossRegistry per game, adopted like the others, and the module instance in defaultGame (civ-clone/web-renderer#405).
unitLosses is state, and UnitLoss is a core entity to hydrate. A file written before it existed loads with no losses (civ-clone/web-renderer#405).
chore: require core-game 0.1.15 and core-unit 0.1.29, for unit losses

One UnitLoss entity per player and unit type, with a count, made the first time a loss is recorded, so a game or an older save starts with none. A ruleset decides what counts as a loss (civ-clone/web-renderer#405).
